# Kerala Tourism

> > Official tourism portal for Kerala, India's premier destination for backwaters, Ayurveda, cultural festivals, and natural beauty.

Kerala Tourism provides comprehensive travel information covering destinations across all districts including Idukki, Alappuzha, Thrissur, Ernakulam, Kottayam, Kollam, Thiruvananthapuram, and Palakkad. The site features cultural highlights like Onam celebrations, Pooram festivals, temple tourism including Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, traditional games, Ayurvedic wellness, and iconic locations such as Fort Kochi and Shanghumugham Beach.

## Key Topics

- Kerala destinations and districts
- Backwater tourism (Alappuzha, Kottayam, Kollam)
- Ayurveda and wellness tourism
- Cultural festivals (Onam, Pooram festivals, Arattu)
- Temple tourism (Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple)
- Fort Kochi heritage
- Hill stations (Idukki, Palkulamedu)
- Traditional Kerala games and cultural heritage
- Accredited service providers
- Accommodation and hotels
- Festival calendar
- Beach destinations (Shanghumugham Beach)
- District-wise attractions (Thrissur, Ernakulam, Thiruvananthapuram, Palakkad)

## Festivals & Cultural Events

- [Festival Calendar of Kerala](https://www.keralatourism.org/festivalcalendar): Calendar of festivals and cultural events across Kerala

## Accommodation & Services

- [Destination and District wise list of hotels in Kerala](https://www.keralatourism.org/hotels): District-wise hotel and accommodation listings for Kerala destinations
- [Accredited Service Providers](https://www.keralatourism.org/accredited-centres): Directory of accredited tourism service providers in Kerala

## Optional

- [Monthly newsletter](https://www.keralatourism.org/newsletter): Monthly newsletter featuring Kerala destinations and cultural heritage
